messages:
ops-lead: Kicking off a router bisection swap now. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Plan: 5% -> 15% -> 30% -> drain -> 60% -> 100% with holds at 15m after 30% and 60%. Abort criteria: p95 +200ms from baseline OR error rate >0.8% sustained >2m. Pin v2 for the route 'chat-api' during the experiment. @raj you'll trigger the drain at 30%. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Deployment job started: release=release-2026-03-21-ops, job_id=deploy-8821. Router target: chat-api. Operator: ops-lead. I'll post weight-change confirmations.

raj: Ack. Drains queued. I'll cordon edge nodes after the 30% step.

maya: Quick note — DB connections baseline is ~1200 RPS, watching for slow queries. If we see connection saturation call abort.

lin: Dashboards: <https://grafana.company/repo/chat-api> p95 baseline 92ms, error rate 0.12%. Also watch router backend 503 count panel.

ops-lead: Commands I will run (will paste results):
```
routerctl set-weight --route chat-api --version v2 --weight 5
routerctl get-weights --route chat-api
```
Hold for 2m at each step unless we hit abort thresholds.

deploy-bot: routerctl: weight set -> route=chat-api version=v2 weight=5% (ok)

maya: p95 -> 98ms, errors steady. DB connections 1250. No red flags.

ops-lead: Proceeding to 15%.

deploy-bot: routerctl: weight set -> route=chat-api version=v2 weight=15% (ok)

lin: Observability peek: small uptick in 504s at the egress -> +0.05% absolute. p95 120ms. Still within thresholds.

ops-lead: Good. Hold 5m and then 30% step. @raj please start edge drain when I 👍 the go at 30%.

(some time passes)

ops-lead: Moving to 30% now.

deploy-bot: routerctl: weight set -> route=chat-api version=v2 weight=30% (ok)

raj: Starting drain for edges serving v1 -> `kubectl -n front cordon edge-5 && kubectl -n front drain edge-5 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

deploy-bot: Edge drain job queued: node=edge-5, status=draining.

maya: Seeing p95 -> 180ms spike on a subset of pods. Error rate 0.9% for last 2m.

ops-lead: @lin and @maya, confirm metrics: is spike localized to a subset of backends or global? If global, we abort to 30% stable.

lin: It's concentrated on a subset: pods with older libhttp (v1.7). 503s correlate with those pods' tail logs -> upstream timeouts.

ops-lead: OK — Rollback decision: immediate partial rollback to 15% and pin v1 on route 'chat-api' for stability while we fix libhttp mismatch. I'll issue rollback and pin.

deploy-bot: routerctl: weight set -> route=chat-api version=v2 weight=15% (ok)

ops-lead: Pinning route to v1 as stable: `routerctl pin --route chat-api --version v1 --reason "auto-stable-rollback-libhttp"`

deploy-bot: route pin created -> route=chat-api pinned_version=v1 (ok)

raj: drain aborted mid-flight, uncordoning edge-5 to get capacity back -> `kubectl uncordon edge-5`

maya: p95 falling back to 105ms, errors 0.15%. DB connections normalizing.

ops-lead: Thanks team. Post-mortem items: 1) backfill test matrix for libhttp v1.7->v2 compatibility 2) add canary scope to exclude old pods 3) update release notes to mention runtime dependency. I'll open the release-note + incident thread after this.

lin: Scheduling a quick revert-hotfix PR for libhttp pins. Will target a small rollout tomorrow.

sara: :thumbsup: Let me know if you want me to extend the change window.

ops-lead: Not needed now. Closing this swap run — we reverted weights and pinned. We'll re-run once libhttp mismatch is resolved. Good catch everyone. :white_check_mark:
